title: Buaflow usage review decision v1
description: What a person decided about one task the usage report raised (EV-012), one file per task in the central store at reviews/<project>/<task>.json. Events are never deleted — an eval case that declares observedIn must stay traceable — so this is what stops a task being raised again: it is decided up to throughEventAt, and only an event after that brings it back.

task.description: <project>/<task>, exactly as the report and `usage show` name it.

outcome.description: eval: an eval case was drafted from it. covered: an existing case already asks this. none: nothing here is Buaflow's to learn — the reason belongs in note.

eval.description: The case this became or is covered by; required when outcome is eval or covered.

decidedBy.description: The person who decided. Never a model: a model may not close its own signal.

throughEventAt.description: The time of the newest event this decision looked at. An event after it raises the task again, because something happened that nobody has judged.

note.description: Why, in one or two sentences. Required in practice for outcome none, where the note is the whole record.
